title: Canvas → Reconstruction → Fragment
asset_strategy: Text-first placeholder carousel using the brand brief and website headings only. Since no image assets are available, design each slide as an archive-style reconstruction system: use minimal typography, negative space, and sequential labels to simulate the transformation from source canvas to digital reconstruction to wearable fragment. Request painting process, digital reconstruction, and product photos for the next version.

slides.headline: One painting.
slides.asset_hint: text-first placeholder; reference website heading 'SEVEN DESIGNS. ONE PAINTING.'
slides.notes: Full-bleed minimal cover. Sparse type. High contrast. Feels like an archive title card.

slides.headline: Source.
slides.notes: Treat as the origin frame. Leave room around the subject. No decorative elements.

slides.headline: Reconstructed.
slides.notes: Present as a technical translation stage. Functional labels only. Calm, precise, mysterious.

slides.headline: Extracted.
slides.notes: Pair source and rebuilt state in one frame. Emphasize the act of selection and removal.

slides.headline: Wearable.
slides.notes: Quiet product reveal. Treat the garment as an object study, not an apparel shot.

slides.headline: Archive.
slides.notes: Closing statement slide. Minimal brand voice. Reinforce the concept without over-explaining.
